testcase.system-out: Scenario: Show the input of a nested sketch ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part in the MCAD Software contains a sketch on the XY plane used by an extrusion ✔ And the origin plane is not persistently visible ✔ When the user chooses Show Input from the sketch row context menu ✔ Then the XY plane row is selected in the model browser ✔ And the XY plane is highlighted in blue in the viewport ✔ When the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the plane highlight is cleared and the shaded solid remains visible
